text:
cheng: observed a regression on the TP/FP8 path after yesterday's kernel bump, 4x nodes, 8-way tensor parallel. tail latency up ~18% on long prompts. attaching quick profile output

maria: which job? can you paste the perf snippet?

cheng: test=tp-gpt2-1B; workload=seq2048; kv-caching=enabled. nsight snapshot shows repeated stall at all-reduce start

cheng: ```
GPU0 kernel: matmul_fp8_fused  avg 1.2ms
allreduce_start     avg 0.9ms (blocked)
wait_for_kv_sync    spikes to 6-8ms
GPU3 kernel: matmul_fp8_fused  avg 1.1ms
```

ryan: hmm, are we seeing mismatch in fp8 scaling across ranks? last roll set scale-to-master=true in the kernel selector. could cause imbalance and extra retries.

maria: also noticed alignment with batch packing heuristics. small batches cause more frequent KV flushes which blow up collective frequency. we should check batching window size.

olivia: quick triage: can we reproduce on int8 path or with fp32 kernels? if fp32 is fine it's likely quantization scaling or the new kernel's pre/post scaling ordering.

cheng: ran a microbenchmark: fp32 path baseline (same config) -> p50 28ms, p99 48ms; fp8 path -> p50 33ms, p99 69ms. int8 path (experimental) -> p50 31ms, p99 52ms. so fp8 worse on tails.

perf-ci: CI profile summary: regression introduced in commit 1a2b3c4 (kernel selector rework). Heuristic now prefers fused matmul for layers > 1024 seq when TP>1.

ryan: that matches. fused matmul_fp8_fused uses a shared scaling op per-shard which may be non-deterministic order with KV update callbacks, causing small lock contention before all-reduce kicks in.

maria: quick mitigation ideas: 1) force old kernel for FP8 when TP>1 until we fix scaling ordering 2) increase batching_window_ms from 5 -> 15 to amortize KV flushes 3) disable scale-to-master for FP8 and use per-rank stable scales

cheng: tried (1) and (2) in staging: forcing legacy kernel reduces p99 back to 50ms, batching_window=15 reduces spikes but increases p50 by ~2ms. promising.

olivia: can we add a guard: if tp_degree>1 && quant_mode==fp8 && seq>1024 then pick legacy kernel? less risky than reverting full selector.

ryan: agreed. I'll open a tiny PR to add that fast-path guard and also add an assertion in the kernel that scaling order is consistent across ranks.

devops-bot: deploy started for canary on ci-tp-4 (2 nodes) by ryan. status: running

maria: also let's add an e2e that runs long prompt with kv-cache churn to catch this in future. short unit tests missed it.

cheng: filed perf issue with logs and nsight captures: https://redwood-internal/issue/INF-1427  tagging @ryan @maria. will monitor canary results. :thumbsup:

perf-ci: note: adding a regression test that runs 2000-token inference across TP=4 against both FP8 and INT8 kernels. failing tests should block selector rollouts.

olivia: thanks all — if canary looks good, let's schedule selector rework follow-up to make fp8 scaling ordering deterministic.

cheng: confirmed canary p99 back to ~49ms on canary. closing temporary rollback after PR lands. will keep monitoring for a day.

ryan: PR merged, thanks. next steps: instrument timing around kv callback and add a microbench for scale sync time.

cheng: great work.
